exams.daily_tip: Prioritize Tier-2 Arithmetic, Data Interpretation, and the qualifying Computer module from day one.
Practice 35 WPM English typing alongside Tier-1 mocks so the mandatory skill test does not eliminate you.
Final merit depends purely on Session-2 (English and General Awareness); treat Math and Reasoning as qualifying.

exams.exam_name: SSC GD Constable (CAPF / SSF / Assam Rifles)
exams.daily_tip: Combine daily 5 km morning track runs with 80-question 60-minute speed mock tests.

exams.exam_name: SSC CPO (Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police & CAPF)
exams.daily_tip: Master English comprehension and grammar, as Tier-2 consists of a 200-mark standalone English paper.
Solve the last 15 years of SSC JE and ESE objective questions for both Paper-1 and Paper-2.
With zero Mathematics in the syllabus, dedicate 2 hours daily to 80–100 WPM shorthand dictation.
Check zone-wise technical and graduate posts carefully, as niche roles have significantly lower cut-offs.
Practice daily bilingual translation passages and idioms to score high in the descriptive paper.
Focus heavily on the 50-mark Current Affairs & Static GK section plus the 10-mark MS Excel/Word questions.
Focus on 35-mark Reasoning and 30-mark Maths speed drills while keeping negative attempts under 10%.

exams.target_window: Apply by 13 Nov; Fee by 15 Nov
exams.daily_tip: Complete your online application today and verify your post preference order for Commercial & Accounts Clerk.
Study Class 9 and 10 NCERT Science concepts and numericals thoroughly for the 25-mark General Science section.
Master Basic Science & Engineering Drawing for CBT-2 and ensure your A1 vision standards are verified.
For Grade 1 Signal, prioritize Basic Electronics, Computer Architecture, and Physics numericals.
Do not neglect CBT-1 non-technical Maths and General Science while revising your core engineering branch.
Practice solving 35 Arithmetic and 35 Reasoning questions within 50 minutes to leave 40 minutes for GS.
Train for the 1600m run (5 min 45 sec limit) alongside daily 90-minute CBT mock tests.
Prepare notes on the History of Indian Railways, DFCCIL corridors, and Customer Relations for 24 bonus marks.
Revise standard JB Gupta and RK Rajput objective banks along with regional language qualifying rules.

exams.exam_name: UPSC Civil Services Exam (IAS / IPS / IFS)
exams.daily_tip: Finish your Mains Optional subject before January and solve at least 30 CSAT comprehension and math papers.
Since IFoS Prelims cut-offs are 15–20 marks higher than CSE, master Environment, Ecology, and Agriculture updates.
Dedicate 2 hours daily to Paper-1 (Project Management, Ethics, Material Science) alongside core technical PYQs.

exams.exam_name: UPSC CDS (Combined Defence Services I & II)
exams.daily_tip: Speed up your 10th-level Trigonometry, Mensuration, and Geometry calculations for the 100-mark Elementary Maths paper.
Clear the 25% sectional cutoff in the 300-mark Mathematics paper using RS Aggarwal and past 10-year NDA papers.
Practice handwriting 300-word essays and counter-arguments in Paper-2 within strict time limits.
Master Class 11 Accountancy, Labour Laws, and Social Security schemes—they account for nearly 35% of the paper.
Focus on General Medicine, Pediatrics, and PSM clinical vignettes from the past 10 years of UPSC CMS papers.
Revise core Hydrogeology, Geophysics, and Analytical Chemistry concepts for both Prelims and descriptive Mains.
Focus on Econometrics, Indian Economic Survey data, and Probability Distributions using past conventional papers.
Practice variable-based seating puzzles and arithmetic caselet DI sets rather than relying on simple Prelims questions.
With no interview round, aim for 80+ accurate attempts in Prelims and build a 6-month Banking Awareness repository.
Respect sectional cut-offs and practice typing a 250-word essay and formal letter directly on the keyboard.
Master Simplification, Approximation, Number Series, and Quadratic Equations—they form 60% of Prelims Quant.

exams.exam_name: IBPS SO (Specialist Officer - IT, Agri, Law)
exams.daily_tip: Treat Prelims as purely qualifying; your final selection depends 100% on the 60-mark Professional Knowledge Mains paper.

exams.exam_name: IBPS RRB Officer Scale-I (Regional Rural Bank PO)
exams.daily_tip: Prelims has only Reasoning and Quant (45 minutes total); practice rapid question switching to maximize score.
State cut-offs frequently cross 72/80; drill 45-minute full mocks daily to eliminate mouse-scroll lag.
Read RBI Annual Reports, Monetary Policy statements, and PIB summaries daily for the Phase-2 ESI & Finance descriptive papers.
Prelims cut-offs exceed 88/100 in most zones—prioritize 100% accuracy in English and Numerical Ability.
Focus on the qualifying decision-making section and master Agriculture & Rural Development (ARD) government schemes.
Build strong fundamentals in Companies Act, Costing, Management, and Financial Markets for the 100-mark Paper-2.
Prepare MSME lending policies, Priority Sector Lending (PSL) norms, and 3 online descriptive essays.
Leverage your banking/financial experience with deep revision of Financial Awareness and Computer Knowledge.
Follows the IBPS PO Mains blueprint closely; focus on housing finance updates and Computer Aptitude.

exams.exam_name: State Cooperative Bank Exams (MSC Bank / APCOB)
exams.daily_tip: Conducted on the IBPS pattern; add state cooperative society acts to your regular banking preparation.
Clear the mandatory sectional cutoff in Insurance & Financial Market Awareness using IC-38 study notes.
Great work-life balance clerical role; keep your regional language grammar sharp for the qualifying language test.
Combine standard banking Prelims prep with insurance marketing concepts and interview communication skills.
Practice 20-minute sectional mocks and revise the last 4 months of financial and insurance current affairs.
Solved on the 150-question NTA pattern; maintain a 35 WPM English typing speed alongside NCERT-level GK.
Score easy marks in Spatial Ability (rotated blocks, hidden figures) and basic arithmetic word problems.

exams.exam_name: Indian Army Agniveer (GD / Tech / Clerk / Tradesman)
exams.daily_tip: Clear the online Computer Based Exam first, then peak your 1.6 km sprint and 10 pull-ups for the physical rally.

exams.exam_name: Indian Air Force Agniveer Vayu (Science & Non-Science)
exams.daily_tip: Focus on Class 12 Physics formula application and English grammar (Active/Passive, Narration, Prepositions).
Maintain a concise formula handbook for 10+2 Calculus, Mechanics, and Electricity to solve 100 questions in 60 minutes.

exams.exam_name: Indian Coast Guard (Navik GD / DB & Yantrik)
exams.daily_tip: Stage-1 has zero negative marking—attempt every single question before the timer expires.
Prepare statement-based current affairs for Tier-1 and internal security essay topics for Tier-2.
Ensure you have your local state domicile certificate and strong command of local language translation for Tier-2.

exams.exam_name: State Police Sub-Inspector (MPSC PSI / UP SI / Bihar Daroga)
exams.daily_tip: Study the updated Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) provisions, Constitutional Polity, and state-specific geography.
Balance daily track endurance workouts (1600m / 5km, shot put) with district-level GK and basic arithmetic.
Ideal for employed graduates aged 18–42; focus on Elementary Mathematics and SSB psychological readiness.

exams.exam_name: State PCS Upper Subordinate (MPSC Rajyaseva / UPPSC / BPSC)
exams.daily_tip: Combine UPSC standard reference books (Laxmikanth, Spectrum) with your state's latest Economic Survey and Budget.

exams.exam_name: MPSC Combined Group B & C (PSI / STI / ASO / Clerk)
exams.daily_tip: Master Maharashtra History, 11th State Board Geography, and Balasaheb Shinde / Pal & Suri grammar books.
Practice TCS-pattern English vocabulary, regional literature authors, and land-record administrative terminology.

exams.exam_name: State CET / PET Screening (UPSSSC PET / RSMSSB CET / HSSC)
exams.daily_tip: Aim for the 95th+ percentile in table/graph Data Interpretation so you qualify for all downstream Mains vacancies.

exams.exam_name: State High Court Recruitment (ASO / Stenographer / Clerk)
exams.daily_tip: Maintain 95%+ accuracy in legal English typing tests and revise High Court civil/criminal manual basics.
Direct single-stage IBPS/TCS exams; focus on Panchayati Raj (73rd & 74th Amendments) and post-specific technical MCQs.
Study India State of Forest Report (ISFR) statistics and build stamina for the 25 km physical walk test.

exams.exam_name: FCI (Food Corporation of India - AG-III & Manager)
exams.daily_tip: Combines banking-style speed Maths/Reasoning/English with a 25-mark NCERT Class 8–10 History and Science section.
ESIC UDC mirrors the IBPS Clerk syllabus plus Static GK—making it an easy parallel target for banking aspirants.

exams.exam_name: NVS & EMRS Non-Teaching (JSA / Accountant / Lab Attendant)
exams.daily_tip: Master basic Computer Operations (MS Office shortcuts, cyber security) and Class 10 lab equipment rules.
Lock in all 28 marks from Engineering Mathematics and General Aptitude before tackling tough 2-mark core numericals.
Solve 15 years of ISRO and GATE 1-mark questions rapidly and prepare 3 core undergraduate subjects deeply for the interview.
For CEPTAM STA-B (B.Sc/Diploma), Tier-1 is purely non-technical aptitude—score 85%+ to reach the core Tier-2 paper.
Clear the CBT cutoff via fast numerical solving, then prepare to derive graphs and first principles on a whiteboard in the interview.
65% of the syllabus is Core CS (Algorithms, OS, DBMS, Computer Networks, Compiler Design) and 35% is Quant/Reasoning.

exams.exam_name: AAI ATC (Junior Executive Air Traffic Control)
exams.daily_tip: Open to B.Tech and B.Sc (Physics & Maths) with zero negative marking; revise Class 11–12 Physics and Calculus thoroughly.

exams.exam_name: Maharatna Separate PSU Exams (HPCL / BEL / BHEL / CIL)
exams.daily_tip: Non-GATE PSU exams give 50% weightage to fast non-technical Aptitude/English and 50% to single-formula core MCQs.

exams.exam_name: State Electricity Boards (MSEDCL / Mahatransco / UPPCL AE & JE)
exams.daily_tip: Practice IBPS-style technical reasoning alongside Power Systems, Electrical Machines, and basic Marathi/regional grammar.

exams.exam_name: CPWD & State PWD / WRD (AE & JE Civil/Mech/Elec)

exams.exam_name: CSIR CASE (Section Officer & Assistant Section Officer)

Score 38+ out of 50 questions in Paper-1 (Teaching/Research Aptitude, DI, Indian Logic) to cross the JRF cutoff.

exams.exam_name: CSIR NET (Life, Chemical, Physical & Mathematical Sciences)

Master NCF 2005, NEP 2020, and Piaget/Vygotsky/Kohlberg theories for Child Development and Pedagogy (CDP).

exams.exam_name: State TET & TAIT (MAHA TET / UPTET / REET / SUPER TET)
exams.daily_tip: Read State Board textbooks from Class 3 to Class 10 cover-to-cover for Environmental Studies, Science, and Social Studies.

exams.exam_name: KVS & NVS Recruitment (PRT / TGT / PGT Teachers)

exams.exam_name: B.Ed Common Entrance Tests (MAH B.Ed CET / UP B.Ed / RIE CEE)

Combine IBPS PO-level Quant and Reasoning practice with online descriptive essay/precis writing.

exams.exam_name: State Judicial Services (PCS-J / Civil Judge Junior Division)
exams.daily_tip: Read Bare Acts daily for BNS, BNSS, BSA, CPC, Transfer of Property Act, and recent Supreme Court landmark judgments.

exams.exam_name: JEE Main & JEE Advanced (IIT / NIT / IIIT Entrance)

90 out of 180 questions are Biology—every single diagram, scientist biography, and summary table in Class 11–12 NCERT is mandatory.

exams.exam_name: State Engineering & Pharmacy CET (MHT-CET / KCET / WBJEE)
exams.daily_tip: With zero negative marking in MHT-CET, focus on speed solving 150 questions and 100% question completion.

exams.exam_name: CUET UG & PG (Central Universities Entrance Test)
exams.daily_tip: Stick strictly to Class 12 NCERT domain chapters and practice case-study passages for Delhi University and BHU admissions.
In the 40-minute DILR section, spend the first 4 minutes scanning all 4 sets to pick the 2 most solvable sets.

exams.exam_name: MBA Entrance Exams (XAT / SNAP / CMAT / MAH-MBA-CET)
exams.daily_tip: Practice ethical Decision Making case studies for XAT and visual abstract reasoning speed drills for MAH-MBA-CET.
Build a 300+ WPM reading speed using newspaper editorials to tackle lengthy Legal and Logical Reasoning passages.
Complete at least 3 full revisions of ICAI study material and write 2 full 3-hour mock papers before every attempt.
Mathematics carries 50% of total marks (600/1200)—master Vectors, Probability, Calculus, and Coordinate Geometry.

exams.exam_name: BITSAT & IISER IAT (12th Science Premier Entrances)
exams.daily_tip: Practice the 30-question English Proficiency & Logical Reasoning section in BITSAT to unlock the 12 bonus questions.
